articles.title_en: Informality in food environments: a systematic scoping review of nutrition, livelihood, and sociopolitical outcomes and implications for food policy
articles.title_cn: 食物环境中的非正规性：关于营养、生计和社会政治结果及食物政策启示的系统性范围综述
articles.abstract_en: Over one billion people in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) work in food systems, including informal actors such as traditional, street, and mobile vendors, who contribute to food environments critical for food and nutrition security. Despite their role in LMIC food environments, research on how informality is defined and its influence remains limited, creating significant policy gaps. This systematic scoping review addresses these gaps by examining how informality in food environments is defined and empirically studied, and how it intersects with nutrition within livelihood and sociopolitical contexts. A search was conducted across fourteen databases on studies published in English after 2000. From 23,250 records, 327 studies across 64 countries were included. Most research (84%) was conducted in urban settings and employed a diverse range of methodologies. Fewer than 25% of articles explicitly defined informality, as compared to the three components of informality defined by the International Labor Organization: 83% of studies defined informality as goods produced for markets, 23% referred to private enterprises, and only 10% mentioned social protection for vendors. Common food products studied included prepared foods, beverages, and vegetables. Key sociopolitical factors influencing informality were regulation, governance, gender dynamics, and access to water, sanitation, and public spaces. Main livelihood challenges included business operations, vendor interactions, and working hours. Results demonstrate that informal food environments are a linchpin for food security and livelihoods in LMICs. Without understanding informal food environment actors from an interdisciplinary and multidimensional perspective, policies will continue to miss these important food system actors.
articles.abstract_cn: 在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs），超过十亿人从事食物系统工作，包括传统、街头和流动摊贩等非正规参与者，他们为对食物和营养安全至关重要的食物环境做出贡献。尽管他们在LMIC食物环境中发挥作用，但关于非正规性如何定义及其影响的研究仍然有限，造成了显著的政策空白。本系统性范围综述通过考察食物环境中的非正规性如何被定义和实证研究，以及它如何在生计和社会政治背景下与营养相交，来弥补这些空白。对十四个数据库中2000之后以英文发表的研究进行了检索。从23,250条记录中，纳入了涵盖64个国家的327项研究。大多数研究（84%）在城市环境中进行，并采用了多样化的方法。与25%篇文章相比，明确界定非正规性的文章更少，而国际劳工组织定义的非正规性三个组成部分分别是：83%项研究将非正规性定义为为市场生产的商品，23%项涉及私营企业，只有10%项提到摊贩的社会保护。研究的常见食品包括预制食品、饮料和蔬菜。影响非正规性的关键社会政治因素包括监管、治理、性别动态以及水、卫生设施和公共空间的获取。主要生计挑战包括业务运营、摊贩互动和工作时间。结果表明，非正规食物环境是LMIC食物安全和生计的关键。如果不从跨学科和多维度的角度理解非正规食物环境参与者，政策将继续忽视这些重要的食物系统参与者。

articles.title_en: Advancing sustainable food systems cooperation in trade agreements: Lessons from Chile
articles.title_cn: 在贸易协定中推进可持续粮食系统合作：智利的经验教训
articles.abstract_en: The transition toward sustainable food systems that ensure food security and adequate nutrition is increasingly urgent. Although trade and investment agreements have sometimes hindered this transition, their potential to support it remains underexplored. Chile offers an illustrative case: its liberalised agro-export model has produced a highly industrialised food system, while the country faces rising diet-related diseases and has developed pioneering nutrition policies. In 2023, Chile and the European Union (EU) signed an Advanced Framework Agreement that includes a Sustainable Food Systems (SFS) Chapter, representing an attempt to align sustainability objectives with trade policy. This study examined how actor interactions, power dynamics, and feasibility conditions shaped the agenda-setting, chapter-drafting, and legitimation of the SFS Chapter, using a theory-informed qualitative design based on semi-structured interviews and documentary analysis. The findings highlight the EU’s role in promoting the chapter within a context characterised by the convergence of global agendas and domestic policy developments. Although introduced at an advanced stage of the negotiations, Chile was not a passive policy-taker and actively shaped the chapter’s scope and legal character. Its broad acceptance was facilitated by its cooperative and non-binding nature, while the limited participation of the health and environment sectors contributed to approaches wherein concepts such as One Health and ‘sustainable diets’ were negotiated primarily through trade and agricultural perspectives. These findings contribute to understanding the governance conditions that shape the incorporation of sustainability-oriented policy innovations into trade agreements and offer lessons for countries seeking to meaningfully integrate health and sustainability objectives into trade policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 向确保粮食安全和充足营养的可持续粮食系统转型日益紧迫。尽管贸易和投资协定有时阻碍了这一转型，但其支持转型的潜力仍未得到充分探索。智利提供了一个说明性案例：其自由化的农产品出口模式产生了高度工业化的粮食系统，而该国面临日益上升的饮食相关疾病，并制定了开创性的营养政策。在2023年，智利与欧盟（EU）签署了一项包含可持续粮食系统（SFS）章节的高级框架协定，代表着将可持续目标与贸易政策相协调的一次尝试。本研究考察了行为体互动、权力动态和可行性条件如何塑造了SFS章节的议程设定、章节起草和合法化，采用基于半结构化访谈和文献分析的理论指导的定性设计。研究结果凸显了欧盟在由全球议程与国内政策发展趋同所构成的背景下推动该章节的作用。尽管该章节在谈判的后期阶段才被引入，智利并非被动的政策接受者，而是积极塑造了该章节的范围和法律性质。其广泛接受得益于其合作性和非约束性，而卫生和环境部门的有限参与促成了诸如“同一健康”和“可持续膳食”等概念主要通过贸易和农业视角进行谈判的方式。这些发现有助于理解塑造可持续导向政策创新纳入贸易协定的治理条件，并为寻求将健康和可持续目标有意义地纳入贸易政策的国家提供了经验教训。

articles.title_en: Adaptive food and nutrition Governance: The Role of regional and subregional technical platforms and partnerships amidst a Crisis of multilateralism
articles.title_cn: 适应性粮食与营养治理：多边主义危机中区域和次区域技术平台与伙伴关系的作用
articles.abstract_en: The weakening of global multilateral mechanisms has opened space for regional and subregional level technical partnerships to function as adaptive governance mechanisms. This paper contends that these partnerships can function as adaptive governance mechanisms in a context where global multilateral cooperation is becoming ineffective. By applying the Political Economy Analysis (PEA) framework, we posit that regional and subregional technical partnerships offer a possible model for reimagining food and nutrition governance. These platforms have succeeded by prioritizing delivery on technical goals (e.g. locust control, healthy school meals), and inclusive leadership. Further, these bridging structures are less susceptible to the erosion of global-level multilateralism because they are grounded in the immediate economic and environmental realities faced by the member countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球多边机制的弱化为区域和次区域层面的技术伙伴关系发挥适应性治理机制的作用开辟了空间。本文认为，在全球多边合作日益失效的背景下，这些伙伴关系可以作为适应性治理机制发挥作用。通过运用政治经济学分析（PEA）框架，我们提出区域和次区域技术伙伴关系为重新构想粮食与营养治理提供了一种可能的模式。这些平台之所以成功，在于优先落实技术目标（例如蝗虫防治、健康学校供餐）以及包容性领导。此外，这些桥梁性结构较不易受到全球层面多边主义削弱的影响，因为它们立足于成员国所面临的直接经济与环境现实。

articles.title_en: The intensive margin of food access and its association with health outcomes: evidence of heterogeneous effects across U.S. Communities
articles.title_cn: 食物获取的集约边际及其与健康结果的关联：来自美国社区间异质性效应的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine how the local food environment relates to health by shifting attention from the extensive margin (counts of food outlets) to the intensive margin, measured by the sales share of healthful retailers. Using a large national establishment dataset merged with tract-level health outcomes, we construct a sales-based healthfulness index of tract-level food environments and estimate its relationship with obesity, diabetes, high blood pressure, mental health issues, and depression of residents. We apply double/debiased machine learning with cross-fitting to flexibly adjust for high-dimensional socioeconomic and built-environment covariates and to separate intensive-margin access from overall retailer density. We find that higher healthful food-sales shares are positively associated with improved health outcomes; a 10-point increase in the healthful food sales share is associated with a 0.87 percentage-point lower obesity prevalence, a 0.19 percentage-point lower diabetes prevalence, and a 0.61 percentage-point lower high blood pressure prevalence, with similar improvements in mental health issues and depression. These associations are heterogeneous across baseline food environments: cardiometabolic outcomes respond most strongly in low-access tracts, while mental health improvements are larger in mid- and high access communities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将关注点从外延边际（食品零售点数量）转向集约边际（以健康食品零售商的销售份额衡量），考察当地食物环境与健康的关系。利用一个大型全国性企业机构数据集，并与普查区层面的健康结果合并，我们构建了普查区层面食物环境的基于销售额的健康度指数，并估计其与居民肥胖、糖尿病、高血压、心理健康问题和抑郁的关系。我们采用双重/去偏机器学习与交叉拟合，以灵活调整高维社会经济和建成环境协变量，并将集约边际获取与整体零售商密度分离。我们发现，较高的健康食品销售份额与更好的健康结果正相关；健康食品销售份额每增加10点，与肥胖患病率降低0.87个百分点、糖尿病患病率降低0.19个百分点、高血压患病率降低0.61个百分点相关，心理健康问题和抑郁也有类似改善。这些关联在基线食物环境间存在异质性：心血管代谢结果在低获取普查区反应最强，而心理健康改善在中等和高获取社区更大。

articles.title_en: Logistics and product quality in perishable food trade
articles.title_cn: 易腐食品贸易中的物流与产品质量
articles.abstract_en: Growth in trade of perishable foods has significantly increased global access to fresh foods, but important trade-offs arising from perishability are not captured in standard trade models. In this paper, we develop a model of age-related product freshness that places importer logistics choices at the center of the analysis. The model highlights order size and order frequency as key trade margins, alongside the nonlinear pricing that arises from scale economies in trade. Importers determine freshness through their order-size and order-frequency choices, balancing a cost–quality trade-off. This has important implications for understanding the quality effects of growth, innovation, and trade policy. For instance, while innovations in cold-chain technology directly improve freshness, their overall effect depends on importers’ logistics choices, which also influence the carbon emissions associated with perishable trade. Fresh seafood is one of the most successful categories in the global expansion of fresh food trade. Using transaction-level data on Norwegian seafood exports from the world’s largest exporter of fresh seafood, we document that order-size discounts are important. We use the model to evaluate how reductions in perishability and protective tariffs affect trade outcomes and product freshness.
articles.abstract_cn: 易腐食品贸易的增长显著增加了全球获得新鲜食品的机会，但由易腐性产生的重要权衡并未在标准贸易模型中得到体现。在本文中，我们构建了一个与年龄相关的新鲜度模型，将进口商物流选择置于分析的中心。该模型强调订单规模和订单频率作为关键贸易边际，以及由贸易规模经济产生的非线性定价。进口商通过其订单规模和订单频率选择决定新鲜度，在成本—质量权衡之间进行平衡。这对于理解增长、创新和贸易政策的质量效应具有重要意义。例如，尽管冷链技术创新直接改善新鲜度，但其总体效应取决于进口商的物流选择，而这些选择也影响与易腐贸易相关的碳排放。新鲜海产品是全球新鲜食品贸易扩张中最成功的类别之一。我们使用来自全球最大新鲜海产品出口国的挪威海产品出口的交易层面数据，记录了订单规模折扣的重要性。我们使用该模型评估易腐性和保护性关税的下降如何影响贸易结果和产品新鲜度。

articles.title_en: Universal free school meals and household food spending: heterogeneous effects across two policy episodes
articles.title_cn: 全民免费学校餐与家庭食品支出：两个政策时期的异质性效应
articles.abstract_en: This study estimates the household-level effects of Universal Free School Meals (UFSM) unavailability across two policy episodes: the federal UFSM expiration in 2022–2023 and state-level UFSM adoptions in 2023–2024. Using the Census Household Pulse Survey and a doubly robust difference-in-differences design, we find that UFSM unavailability raises weekly household food-at-home spending by $30.77 per week in the 2022–2023 sample and by $13.54 in the 2023–2024 sample. It raises food-away-from-home spending by $11.21 and $14.24 per week, respectively, and increases the probability that paying for school meals made it difficult to cover other household expenses by 9.2 percentage points, among households that paid for school meals. Income-stratified estimates show the largest food-at-home spending responses among households between 185 and 250 percent of the federal poverty level, just above the reduced-price eligibility threshold, and the reported burden of paying for school meals extends to roughly 250 percent of that level. A causal forest confirms formally detectable and replicable heterogeneity in food-at-home responses in both samples. Households with the largest responses are not concentrated among those already eligible for free or reduced-price meals. The income band immediately above the threshold is over-represented in both episodes, and about two-thirds would pay full price under current rules. Among these households, composition and rates of physical limitations rather than income distinguish the largest responders. The burden of school meal costs thus extends well beyond the population reached by income-targeted eligibility.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究估计了全民免费学校餐（UFSM）不可获得在两个政策时期对家庭层面的效应：2022-2023年联邦UFSM到期和2023-2024年州级UFSM采纳。使用人口普查家庭脉搏调查和双重稳健双重差分设计，我们发现UFSM不可获得使2022-2023样本中每周家庭在家食品支出增加$30.77，使2023-2024样本中增加$13.54。它分别使外出就餐支出每周增加$11.21和$14.24，并在支付学校餐的家庭中，使支付学校餐难以覆盖其他家庭支出的概率增加9.2个百分点。按收入分层的估计显示，在家食品支出反应最大的是联邦贫困线185至250%之间的家庭，刚好高于减价资格阈值，而支付学校餐的报告负担延伸至该水平的约250%。因果森林确认了两个样本中在家食品反应存在形式上可检测且可复制的异质性。反应最大的家庭并不集中在已经符合免费或减价餐资格的家庭中。紧高于阈值的收入带在两个时期中均过度代表，约三分之二在当前规则下将支付全价。在这些家庭中，区分最大反应者的是构成和身体限制率而非收入。因此，学校餐成本的负担远远超出了收入定向资格所覆盖的人群。

articles.title_en: Income and food price shocks, urban food security, and dietary deprivation: Evidence from Dakar, Senegal
articles.title_cn: 收入与食品价格冲击、城市粮食安全与膳食剥夺：来自塞内加尔达喀尔的证据
articles.abstract_en: Understanding household food behavior is key to anticipating the welfare effects of economic shocks, particularly in urban areas where COVID-19 disrupted livelihoods and food access. While a growing body of literature documents the pandemic’s effects on food security, few studies explicitly integrate households’ pre-pandemic sensitivity to income and price changes. This study examines household food demand in Dakar, Senegal, and evaluates the simulated effects of COVID-19-related income contractions and food price increases on food security and diet quality. Using statistically matched household surveys, we estimate a censored Quadratic Almost Ideal Demand System model with subgroup-specific elasticities and develop a microsimulation model incorporating a heterogeneous Engel transmission channel across six counterfactual scenarios combining three income levels with two food price scenarios. The estimates reveal that households are highly sensitive to price shocks, particularly for staples and animal-source foods, while income shocks transmit partially to food expenditure, with subgroup-specific transmission. Simulated shocks reduce average caloric intake by 17%–36% and lower the food security rate from 52% at baseline to between 40% and 22% depending on the scenario, with statistically significant heterogeneity across sociodemographic groups. The Resilient Diet Deprivation index further reveals a simultaneous deterioration in diet quality through wider and deeper food group deficits, with the contribution of staples and animal-source foods to dietary deprivation rising across all scenarios. These findings underscore the importance of price stabilization policies, nutrition-sensitive interventions, and targeted social protection to strengthen household resilience in urban West Africa.
articles.abstract_cn: 理解家庭食品行为是预判经济冲击福利效应的关键，尤其是在COVID-19扰乱生计和食品获取的城市地区。尽管越来越多的文献记录了疫情对粮食安全的影响，但很少有研究明确纳入家庭在疫情前对收入和价格变化的敏感性。本研究考察塞内加尔达喀尔的家庭食品需求，并评估COVID-19相关的收入收缩和食品价格上涨对粮食安全和膳食质量的模拟影响。利用统计匹配的家庭调查，我们估计了一个带有子组特定弹性的删失二次几乎理想需求系统模型，并开发了一个微观模拟模型，该模型在结合三种收入水平与两种食品价格情景的六个反事实情景中纳入了异质性恩格尔传导渠道。估计结果显示，家庭对价格冲击高度敏感，尤其是对主食和动物源食品，而收入冲击部分传导至食品支出，且传导具有子组特异性。模拟冲击使平均热量摄入减少17%–36%，并使粮食安全率从基线的52%降至40%至22%之间（取决于情景），且在社会人口群体间存在统计上显著的异质性。韧性膳食剥夺指数进一步揭示，膳食质量同时恶化，表现为食物组缺口更广、更深，且主食和动物源食品对膳食剥夺的贡献在所有情景中均上升。这些发现凸显了价格稳定政策、营养敏感型干预和有针对性的社会保护对增强西非城市家庭韧性的重要性。
